target_customer: NYC landlords, property managers and sellers who list rentals
problem: Traditional brokerage rental commissions are high, and after the FARE Act landlords must pay the broker fee and handle tours, applications and screening.
business_model: Brokerage commission, about 4 percent of rent (about a third of the typical rate), with an AI agent handling inquiries and scheduling
product_category: AI powered residential real estate brokerage

founders.name: Raymond Allie
founders.background_notes: A startup directory ties the team to Cornell University, not confirmed on the YC page.

founders.name: Aryan Sharma
founders.role: COO (listed as CFO in the role header)
founders.background_notes: YC page header says CFO, bio says COO.

competitors.name: Openigloo
competitors.what: Landlord services in beta and AI tools for NYC rentals after the FARE Act
competitors.traction_then: More users after June 2025; leasing part of a Silverstein Properties portfolio

technical_complexity.rationale: AI scheduling, screening and listing syndication on top of existing models is standard engineering; the hard part is brokerage licensing and operations.

defensibility.rationale: A real estate license is required, but other discount brokerages and landlords bringing leasing in-house can copy the model.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition found. A legal challenge to the FARE Act was pending as of September 2025 and no ruling was found.

market_need_then: The FARE Act (June 2025) barred landlords from passing broker fees to tenants, pushing landlords to look for cheaper leasing. The Real Deal in August 2025 named Spotlight as one discount entrant.

branding.domain_note: Uses spotlight.realty on the .realty TLD; not a .com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and tech forward; tagline The agent that never sleeps.

branding.community_and_virality: Single mention in The Real Deal (2025-08) about new entrants.

brand_strength.rationale: A real word plus category name is easy to say but shared with other realty teams (a Chapel Hill agent team used the same name in search results); only one trade press mention.

outcome_analysis: Spotlight Realty is a Summer 2025 YC company that began serving NYC rentals in June 2025, just as the FARE Act changed who pays broker fees. It undercuts brokers at 4 percent with an AI agent. It is active with no exit or shutdown news, but there is no verified funding or revenue and the legal future of the FARE Act is uncertain.
notes: The Real Deal article fetch returned empty, so its content comes from the search summary. VCBacked reports 500K USD pre-seed announced 2025-09 with YC as investor; unverified so no round recorded. Founder roles conflict across sources (CFO vs COO for Sharma). Third party revenue and valuation estimates were ignored. Location listed as Portland, OR on YC with NYC operations.
